coturnix_japonica_dorsal.species: Coturnix japonica (Japanese quail exhibiting periodic longitudinal dorsal buff-yellow pheomelanin and dark brown-black eumelanin plumage stripes)
coturnix_japonica_dorsal.author: Wayne Cheng (Wikimedia Commons)

somite_agouti_reaction_diffusion_model.section: Haupaix et al. (2018) Science Figs. 1-4 & Inaba et al. (2019) Science Figs. 2-4

governing_pde.u_eq: du/dt = D_u * laplacian(u) + alpha_u * u^2 / (v * (1 + kappa * u^2)) - gamma_u * u + beta_A * S_somite(y)
governing_pde.v_eq: dv/dt = D_v * laplacian(v) + alpha_v * u^2 - gamma_v * v
governing_pde.somite_prepattern: S_somite(y) = sum_k A_somite * exp(-(y - y_k)^2 / (2 * sigma_somite^2)) + A_bead * exp(-((x - x_b)^2 + (y - y_b)^2) / (2 * sigma_bead^2))
governing_pde.pigment_switch_law: Yellow pheomelanin synthesized where Agouti/activator u(x,y) >= theta_A (MC1R antagonism); Black eumelanin synthesized where u(x,y) < theta_A
governing_pde.stripe_width_partition: w_yellow + w_black = Lambda_somite (somite-specified dorsoventral stripe period)

interspecific_somite_grafting_experiment.section: Haupaix et al. (2018) Science Fig. 3 (Heterospecific Somite-to-Dermis Chimeras)

agouti_bead_perturbation_regimes.description: Dominant-negative / RNAi suppression of dermal Agouti shrinks yellow pheomelanin stripes and expands black eumelanin domains
Control BSA bead implantation preserves wild-type Japanese quail yellow (0.42 mm) and black (0.53 mm) stripe widths
Moderate exogenous Agouti protein bead locally widens yellow pheomelanin stripe and narrows adjacent black eumelanin band
High Agouti protein bead produces strong local yellow band expansion (+0.29 mm) with complementary black band narrowing (-0.29 mm)
Saturating exogenous Agouti bead nearly bridges adjacent yellow stripes across the inter-stripe black domain
